shares.title: Share links
shares.intro: A share link lets someone without an account browse one library or one item (a series with its seasons and episodes) until the link expires or you revoke it. Every redemption and use is recorded.

create.title: New share link
create.scopeItem: One item with its seasons and episodes
create.itemIdHint: The ID at the end of the item page's address (/items/…).
create.customExpiryHint: In your local time; at least 5 minutes and at most 90 days from now.
create.readOnlyHint: Guests cannot write anything, not even watched marks or progress.
create.allowNative: Allow native apps to direct play
create.allowNativeHint: Only native (app) clients can redeem a session from this link that may direct play the original files, under the usual delivery rules. Web guests can only browse: the web never plays anything and nothing is transcoded.
create.concurrencyHint: Counts all native guests of this link together.
create.webNotice: Whoever opens the link in a browser gets a guest session that can only browse the shared items. Anyone who has the link can use it, so send it only to the people it is meant for.
create.invalidItem: Enter the item's ID (36 characters, such as 1b4e28ba-2fa1-11d2-883f-0016d3cca427).
create.invalidExpiry: Choose a time at least 5 minutes and at most 90 days from now.
create.invalidConcurrency: Enter a whole number from 1 to {max}.
create.refused: The server cannot create this link. Check the expiry and the other fields.
create.scopeMissing: This library or item does not exist.

grant.title: Copy the new link now
grant.warning: This link is shown only this once. After you close this box it cannot be shown again; if it is lost, revoke the link and create a new one.
grant.label: Share link
grant.copyFailed: The link could not be copied automatically. It is selected; copy it yourself.

list.title: Links
list.emptyHint: The newest 200 links are listed here.
list.native: Native direct play, up to {count} at once
list.revokePrompt: The link stops working at once and its {count} active guest sessions end. This cannot be undone.

access.title: Access log: {scope}
access.caption: Recorded events of the share link, newest first

reason.native: The link does not allow native direct play.
reason.sessionLimit: Too many guest sessions at once.

redeem.title: Shared link
redeem.missing: This address contains no share link. Ask the sender for the complete link.
redeem.signedIn: You are signed in as {name}. Opening the link as a guest signs this browser out of that account.
redeem.continue: Sign out and open as a guest
redeem.failed: The shared link could not be opened.

guest.title: Shared with you
guest.browseOnly: You can browse the shared items here. Nothing plays in the web browser.
guest.empty: There is nothing to show yet.
